findings.summary: The gold focus outline does not contrast sufficiently with light surfaces, making focused controls harder to identify.
findings.fix: Replace the single gold outline with a contrasting double ring, such as a 3px navy outline and an outer cream ring, so focus remains visible on both light surfaces and the dark sidebar.

findings.summary: Responsibility list numbers have insufficient text contrast in both dashboard themes.
findings.fix: Use a dedicated darker gold text color for .responsibility-number in both themes, such as #76521f, which exceeds 4.5:1 on the panel.
findings.evidence: On #fffefa: executive #c18b3b is 2.96:1; operations #b88439 is 3.25:1; 4.5:1 required.

findings.summary: Small page-footer text has insufficient contrast against the page background.
findings.fix: Darken the .page-footer text color; for example, #5d6a72 provides 5.06:1 against --paper #f5f4ef.

passed: Checked executive and operations themes across responsive breakpoints; no responsive color overrides are present.
Review status indicators contrast with the navy panel: good #9cbea5 is 7.14:1 and attention #efc26e is 8.73:1. The template also renders status text beside each aria-hidden indicator.
Checked shared body and dark-panel text colors, plus theme blue text on panels; the tested combinations meet WCAG AA.
